description: ISA-95 ProductDefinition = the recipe / SOLL master. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/product-definition.md, description.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name of the product specification.

properties.name: version_label
properties.description: Functional spec/recipe version (independent of the profile SemVer).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Lifecycle status, e.g. draft, released, obsolete.

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: FK to Article.article_no, reached via OperationsSegment SPECIFIES_MATERIAL. The article this spec defines — the production order / recipe join point. First binding axis.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: Optional FK to an EquipmentClass/line the spec is restricted to, reached via OperationsSegment SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT. Second binding axis.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.
The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: param_name
properties.description: Name of the controlled product property (e.g. a speed, a thickness or a weight per area).

properties.name: target_value
properties.description: Target / SOLL setpoint of the property.

properties.name: unit
properties.description: Unit of the property (UN/CEFACT code recommended).

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: Last change. Server-managed and volatile on every read (sim-v5 returns a fresh value per GET), so promotion:never — kept in the snapshot but excluded from the change-trigger and never published on its own.

properties.name: operations_type
properties.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

properties.name: characteristic_ref
properties.description: The characteristic the band of this parameter comes from: the criterion of the test specification (SMProfile-TestSpecificationCriterion, e.g. the balloon number on the drawing). Empty until a real source names it — never invented.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: B2MML ParameterSpecification has no link to a test criterion (the criterion names the parameter, EvaluatedPropertyID).

properties.name: source_revision
properties.description: The revision of the drawing or document that set the band. Empty until a real source names it — never invented.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: the revision is the version of the test specification the criterion belongs to; B2MML ParameterSpecification has no field for it.

isa95.note: ISA-95 2013: a product definition is an OperationsDefinition of type production. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/product-definition.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML 0701 has no ProductDefinition object; the recipe is an OperationsDefinition. B2MML OperationsDefinition has no lifecycle status and no setup axis; the controlled property with its target and warning/action bands is no named B2MML field; updated_at is a technical timestamp of the source. Audit M3 (core 6.0.0): the specification of one parameter is OperationsSegment.ParameterSpecification (ID = param_name, Value with its UnitOfMeasure); the two bands are nested parameters named warn_lo / warn_hi / action_lo / action_hi. PLM model (owner 29.10.2026): characteristic_ref and source_revision name the characteristic and the drawing revision a band was derived from; B2MML ParameterSpecification has no field for them — the characteristic itself is a TestSpecificationCriteria (SMProfile-TestSpecificationCriterion), its revision the TestSpecification Version.
isa95.grain: one parameter of a product definition: one row = one param_name of one definition (key <definition>.<param_name>)
